Fiesty Fish
By: J4nine
Published: Monday, February 21, 2011 - 12:26pm

Ingredients




Salmon
1 teaspoon Thyme
A Bit Of Salt
Greek Salad
1/4 Mild Chilli Powder

Preparation

1 Wash the Salmon thoroughly three times 2 Sprinkle the chilli powder on the salmon on both sides 3 Then sprinkle some thyme on both sides too 4 Then do it with the salt 5 Then grill it 6 Check on it every five minutes and serve when it's ready
